faq: Can I change the template later?

On Wix, a published site cannot be switched to another template without rebuilding the pages. That is why we help you pick well first. Colors, fonts and sections can still be changed freely afterwards.
Wix templates are included with your Wix account. Plans, domain and paid apps are billed by Wix to you. Our price covers the setup and styling only.
Yes. Tell us what you do and the style you like, and we send two or three template options with a short note on why each fits. You pick, then we start.
Can you add pages the template does not have?
Yes, within the package limits. We copy the template's own style so the new pages match, and we count them against the pages-filled limit in your package.
desc:
Wix template customization and setup turns a ready-made design into a site that looks like your brand. Ecom Swift LLC starts the template in your account, applies your logo, colors and fonts, and fills it with your own content.

## What is Wix template customization?

Wix template customization means taking a design from the Wix library and changing it until it fits your business. We replace the demo text and photos, set your fonts and colors, reshape sections, build the menu and footer, and make sure the pages work on a phone. The structure comes from the template, and the identity comes from you.

You can choose a template yourself, or we suggest two that suit your type of business, so you are not left browsing hundreds of options.

## Why does a template site need real customizing?

An untouched template looks like a template. Visitors may have seen the same layout on other sites, and demo content such as sample names, stock photos and placeholder text signals an unfinished business. Fonts and colors that do not match your logo make the brand feel scattered.

Customizing fixes that without the cost of a fully custom design. You keep a proven layout, which saves time, and replace everything that makes it generic. The result is a site that reads as yours, built faster than starting from a blank page.

## How a tailored template affects trust and enquiries

Visitors decide quickly whether a business looks real. Consistent branding, clear page titles, readable text and working forms all point to a business that is open and active. A contact form that reaches your inbox gives interested visitors an easy way to reply.

Layout choices matter as well. A menu that matches your services, sections ordered around visitor questions and buttons that stand out make the next step obvious. We do not promise a particular number of leads, since that depends on your offer and your traffic, but a coherent, finished site gives every visit a better chance.

## What a good template setup includes

- A template chosen for your type of business and the features you need.
- Your logo placed correctly in the header and as a favicon where included.
- A defined set of fonts and colors applied across all pages.
- All demo text, images and sample items removed.
- Your own pages written into place, with headings that match your services.
- Restyled sections or cards so the design no longer looks stock.
- A working contact form wired to your own inbox.
- A menu and footer customized with your pages and social links.
- Page titles set so each page has a clear name in search results.
- A mobile view checked section by section.

## What we do

We begin by agreeing on the template, or by shortlisting two options for you. We then start the site in your own Wix account, apply your branding and clean out the demo material. Next we fill each page with your content and adjust the layout where your material does not fit.

The Basic package brands the template and fills up to three pages. The Standard package covers more pages, restyles or adds two sections, connects a working contact form and customizes the menu and footer. The Premium package reshapes the template further, with custom button and card styles, a gallery or blog, social links, a favicon and a short video walkthrough. Extra pages, a photo gallery or a blog starter can be added.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Pick a template for its structure, not for its demo photos.
- Send your logo in a high-quality file.
- Provide real text and photos before we start.
- Keep to two or three fonts at most.
- Check the finished site on your own phone.

**Avoid:**
- Choosing a template with features your business will never use.
- Leaving any lorem ipsum or sample content behind.
- Using low-resolution photos stretched across large sections.
- Changing templates halfway through the build.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A new business that needs a professional site without paying for a fully custom design.
- A freelancer who picked a template but got stuck on branding and layout.
- A small team that wants a consistent look across pages, with its own colors and fonts.
- An owner replacing an outdated site who prefers a proven layout over a blank canvas.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors if you have them, a short description of your business and the text and photos for each page. If you have a template in mind, send its name or link. Add us as a collaborator or team member in your Wix account. We never need your password, and we show you a preview before you publish.
